scope: Independent read-only production-source review and targeted orchestration probes; this is not full browser acceptance

reviewed_boundaries.result: Core implements declared reason precedence, retained required inputs, minimum original cutoffs, explicit expiry and Eastern civil rights end. Status/source/rejection/replay/package/destination qualification is explicitly upstream; no missing input was needed to implement this declared family.

Caller clock feeds route_selection; earliest effective expiry/future verification schedules refresh. Fractional cutoff schedules the first representable browser millisecond without changing the exact core cutoff. Backward clock, pin/unpin, hidden/resume and page lifecycle paths were inspected.

Route decisions install before row providers, common fixture/league eligibility and render. Canonical row networks are updated before featured card clones. Open network panels close before route replacement. Details retain source links; provider playback links are separately temporally gated.

Prompt snapshot requests refresh validity before filtering matches and channels. Common eligibility feeds match editorial and recommendations. Calendar editorial retains its separate league/service semantics; full editorial lifetime migration is out of scope.

schedule.js stages template rows and validates every temporal batch with the shared owner before options.apply can mutate live rows; malformed metadata is rejected while expired-but-well-formed routes remain valid input. Reviewed ordering only; actual DOM atomicity is covered by the independent browser verifier.

limitations: DOM/render spies used for focused Node probes; no claim of actual layout, focus or browser event-loop acceptance.
Independent Chromium/WebKit verifier and broader regression runs remain separate acceptance gates.
Fresh listed routes have no universal TTL, usual routes have no contractual start/kickoff gate, and live-only destination checks remain caller-owned as specified.
